examShortTricks: Trick 1: Passive recipe: object → verb 'be' + V3 → by + agent; keep the TENSE in the 'be' — 'is writing' → 'is being written'.
Trick 2: Narration ladder: present → past, will → would, can → could, this → that, now → then, here → there; yesterday → the previous day.
Trick 3: Universal truths stay in present tense in reported speech — the exception that examiners love.
Trick 4: Questions in narration: yes/no → if/whether; wh-words keep their place; statement word order after the connector.
